name: @aceapt/feature-50-speed-training-ui
description: ACEAPT Feature 50 - Speed Training Engine (frontend component module). Drop these components into the existing ACEAPT frontend (spec section 87: 'reuse existing UI architecture') - this is not a standalone app.
notes: Components use Tailwind utility classes - ensure Tailwind is configured in the host app.
src/api/speedApi.ts expects an auth token getter to be provided by the host app (see its top-of-file comment).
src/types/speed.ts intentionally mirrors backend/src/types/domain.ts. In a monorepo, replace both with one shared package.
